slot_scores.name: missing_one_bomb_per_trip_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can a single bombing run carry both a heavy bomb and a light bomb simultaneously, or is each bombing run limited to carrying exactly one bomb (either heavy or light)?
slot_scores.rationale: Explicitly asks about per-trip carrying capacity and whether more than one bomb can be carried in a run, matching the hidden constraint.

slot_scores.name: missing_objective_probability_maximization
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the mission's objective to maximize the probability that at least two of the four key parts are destroyed, or is it to guarantee (i.e., achieve a probability of 1) that at least two parts are destroyed?
slot_scores.rationale: Directly asks about the objective and confirms maximizing the probability of destroying at least two parts.

summary: The agent recovered the core hidden facts—the objective and the one-bomb-per-trip constraint—but then over-questioned with many vague or incomplete prompts without reaching a final modeling state.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
